evidence: Built the requirement -> criterion map from instruction.md, hireops_rules.md and integration.md against all 55 criteria (render 1, constraints 1, functional 43, polish 5, visual 5; counted by [[criterion]] headers). Nearly every product requirement is mapped, often with positive controls: one-stage moves (hro_move_one_stage), arrival at bottom (hro_arrive_bottom), shared manual order (hro_reorder, hro_restart), reject/reason/rejected-from/Hired/reopen (hro_reject_reason, hro_reject_hired, hro_reopen), Interview places incl. bulk and undo overfill (hro_interview_full, hro_interview_reorder_free, hro_bulk_places, hro_undo_full), refused move put back + reason + focus (hro_refused_put_back), stale 409-style refusal naming who (hro_stale_refused), bulk board order / all-or-none (hro_bulk_move, hro_bulk_all_or_none), undo restore / conflict / once / earlier-move-lost (hro_undo_restores, hro_undo_conflict, hro_undo_once; note-does-not-count is implicitly covered because B(12) bundles Rafael's A2 note with Mei's other-card change and hro_undo_conflict fails an app whose undo is then refused), role matrix for recruiters/HMs/observer/candidate/anonymous (hro_mgr_*, hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff, hro_anonymous, hro_notes, hro_thread_access), job open validation 1-50 and HM account (hro_job_open), add-candidate email rules and candidate-account linking (hro_add_candidate, hro_add_email_rules, hro_candidate_linked), Activity incl. refusals and Observer read (hro_activity, hro_activity_refusals), live board/messages/unread/seen within 15 s (hro_live_board, hro_msg_exchange, hro_unread_counts, hro_seen), preservation of open card/note/focus/scroll and reply/focus (hro_pol_live_board, hro_pol_live_thread), latest-30/earlier pages/place kept (hro_thread_latest, hro_thread_earlier, hro_pol_earlier_place), scrolled-up arrival notice (hro_unread_scrolled_up), compose rules (hro_msg_compose), failed send (hro_pol_failed_send), drafts per conversation / reload / ended session / other user (hro_drafts, hro_pol_session_resume, which also covers the unsaved note draft of rules 3 'Internal notes'), candidate wording/privacy (hro_candidate_view, hro_candidate_private), seed-once and restart (hro_restart, Lena's seeded read marker in hro_unread_counts), sign-in (render gate), shared storage (constraints gate), desktop craft (visual). Runtime-contract items (node /app/server.js, port/PORT, /api/health, DB_PATH, no package installs, Node/Express/SQLite, no external data service, relative path resolution rules 8) are launch-contract/template concerns or not browser-decidable; per REVIEW_POLICY a browser judge cannot prove SQLite and must not read source, so they are recorded as accepted non-criterion coverage, not gaps. GAPS FOUND: (1) CONFIRMED UNGRADED: hireops_rules.md:175 'Sending clears the draft.' (instruction.md:7 says only an UNSENT reply stays). hro_msg_compose (functional judge.toml:303-309) checks only that the box is empty and focused immediately after Enter; hro_drafts (judge.toml:366-372) explicitly defers 'Clearing the box after sending' to hro_msg_compose and only reloads with an unsent draft; hro_pol_session_resume (polish judge.toml:54-60) sends the resumed reply and then immediately types a second draft, overwriting any stale stored copy without a reload. No protocol step reloads or revisits a conversation after a send with no new typing, so persistence of the clearing is never observed. The golden does clear it (solution/app/public/js/threads.js:196 keep.set('draft.' + id, '')), so this is a rubric coverage gap, not a golden defect. (2) WEAK/IMPLICIT: hireops_rules.md:84 'A move appears on the mover's board immediately' (optimistic display) has no criterion; move rows grade outcomes without timing and hro_refused_put_back:137 explicitly also passes a UI that refuses before the card moves. An app that shows the mover's own successful move only after its next poll or a reload is not clearly failed by any row. Browser decidability of 'immediately' vs server-confirmed render is low, so this is reported as a minor gap. (3) WEAK/IMPLICIT: hireops_rules.md:180-181 'signing in does not open one for them' (candidate) is only indirectly protected by Lena's unread-count read in hro_unread_counts and by the U protocol moving Tomas to his applications list; no criterion states it. (4) NOTE (lenient, not a false-fail): hireops_rules.md:21-22 and 78 name 403 for role refusals and 409 for stale moves; only 401 (hro_anonymous) and not-found/404 (hro_candidate_private, hro_thread_access) are graded by status, other refusals accept any refusal. (5) NOTE: hireops_rules.md:38 'Identifiers are generated by the workspace' is not graded (the app always generates ids in the UI flow, so low value). None of the gaps is excused by the skill's flow-bundling false positive: they are absent legs, not bundled ones.
counterexample: Broken app: on send it clears the textarea and focus stays (passes hro_msg_compose), but the per-conversation draft stored in localStorage is not removed. Every protocol step still passes (hro_drafts reloads only with an unsent draft; hro_pol_session_resume types a new draft immediately after the resumed send). In real use, reloading or switching back to the conversation after sending refills the box with the already-sent text, inviting a duplicate send, directly contradicting hireops_rules.md:175 'Sending clears the draft.' and instruction.md:7, yet the app can score full Functional/Polish credit for drafts.
suggested_fix: Extend hro_drafts (and protocol T) with one leg: after sending a drafted reply, open another conversation or reload, return, and confirm the box is empty (the unsent-draft reload is the control); optionally add an 'appears on the mover's board without reload' leg to hro_move_one_stage and a 'candidate sign-in shows the list with no conversation open' leg to hro_candidate_view.
